name: Wish-maker
source:
Your mother always told you a story about a being called the 'Wish Maker,' and now you are on a quest to find this mystical entity.

Alone in the middle of the forest, will you be able to find it and make your wish come true?
translation:
你的母亲总是给你讲一个关于一个被称为“许愿者”的生物的故事，现在你正在寻找这个神秘的实体。

独自一人在森林深处，你能找到它并实现你的愿望吗？
